problem: Documentation artifacts with .jsx extensions were being parsed by ESLint/Vite as React code.
solution: Added fullBuildSanitizer import at the top of eslint.config.js so cleanup runs before ESLint config evaluation.
Moved the Vite documentation blocker before React plugin so blocked artifacts are intercepted earlier.
Expanded Vite buildStart cleanup to scan both src and root components directories.
Fixed sanitizer proof count field for strictDuplicateArtifactGuard compatibility.
user_notice: No need to change Regra-Mae for this fix.
